context: The exchange takes place in Sharess Caress with Sauceman Chorizo, the on-site chef and vendor who sells cooking supplies. He’s used to being interrupted and responds wearily to advances, explicitly noting he’s married and not interested. The player can attempt flirtatious or provocative lines, but Chorizo will brush them off and keep the interaction strictly professional. This is a short vendor dialog in the Lower City style—other vendors here also use sassy or flirty banter, and the sample is one possible outcome.
